name: @anywalletkit/protocol-swap2-0x
description: 0x Swap API v2 same-chain swaps through the Permit2 flow: the Settler is read from 0x's on-chain registry, and the Permit2 payload, target, value, recipient, buy token and minimum are checked against the request before anything is signed. Needs a 0x API key (on a backend, or supplied by the integrator).
